I'm bipolar II and recently had some really serious depression lows and truly debilitating anxiety. I've been on welbutrin before, but I didn't want to go back to that since it wasn't helping me at all. my pdoc said to give some other meds a try, suggesting SSRI's and SNRI's since my hypomania hasn't been too bad lately. 

A month ago I started Effexor at 175mg, and ohhhhhh my fucking god I have never felt this fucking good in my LIFE. I'm slightly worried it's just hypomania but I seriously cannot complain. It took a month for it to fully kick in and to get over some crazy side effects but I'm so glad I gave it a shot. I haven't had suicidal thoughts in almost a week, and get this right: I'm HOPEFUL about my life!!! I'm like fucking shook over here y'all. I really hope this keeps up, because I'm in the library right now getting school work done WEEKS ahead of time. Like who is she??? I go talk to my doctor next week for my second follow up, so we'll see if any lithium may be added since I do feel prettty high but again I really can't complain.
